messages:
deploybot: PROD deploy started — service: inference-api, env=prod-us-west-2, tag=release/3.6.0, commit=d4e5f6a. Change window 2026-03-20T18:00Z–19:00Z. Initiated by @Sara. Rollout policy: progressive 10/30/60/100% (5m checks). Automated rollback threshold: error_rate > 1% sustained for 3 consecutive 1m windows -> rollback to release/3.5.9. :shipit:
Sara: starting canary 10% now. watching latency + errors. will call out if anything unexpected. :eyes:
Alan: ack — I'll watch autoscaling and GPU pool metrics. tagging @Meera for kv-cache and OOM noise.
Meera: ack. tailing logs (grep kv-cache OOM). raising alerts for OOM spikes.
telemetry-bot: Canary metrics @ 10%: error_rate=0.20% (baseline 0.15%), p95 latency +28ms vs baseline, GPU utilization normal, no new 5xx patterns. Marking as REVIEW.
Alan: small p95 bump expected for seqlen=512 workload. proceed to 30%?
Sara: proceed to 30% — moving now.
deploybot: traffic shifted -> 30%. Waiting 5m for observation.
eng-oncall: seeing one instance restart in prod-us-west-2-a around 18:12. Pulling logs.
Meera: restart caused by container OOM at 2026-03-20T18:12:34Z, correlated with a prompt spike. Applied temporary restart backoff, scaled replica set +1.
Alan: applied burst capacity and warmed an extra KV cache writer. Re-checking tail.
telemetry-bot: Post-scale: p95 back within +10ms of baseline, error_rate stable. No regression flags.
Sara: continue to 60% when ready.
Alan: rolling to 60% now.
deploybot: traffic shifted -> 60%. Waiting 5m.
telemetry-bot: 60% snapshot: error_rate 0.18%, p95 nominal, no 5xx surge. All thresholds OK.
Sara: final 100% rollout in 2m.
Alan: pinning traffic-router to infra tag v2.1.3 for the next 24h to avoid known corner regression.
Meera: filed follow-up ticket IDS-412 for sequencing/seqlen spikes and oncall doc updates.
Sara: final 100% now.
deploybot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE — tag=release/3.6.0, commit=d4e5f6a. All traffic shifted to release/3.6.0. Duration ~14m. Observability: no active alerts. :white_check_mark: Release notes: https://company.internal/releases/3.6.0 (internal)
releasebot: Release entry published: https://company.internal/releases/3.6.0 — changelog: improved attention kernels, quantization tuning for fp8-like profiles, KV cache warmup, perf regression fixes.
Sara: great work. @release-manager please publish external notes and bump the security manifest.
release-manager: will publish external release notes in 10m and send the customer-facing summary.
eng-oncall: closing monitor window for now. If anything degrades reopen this thread.
Alan: leaving a quick postmortem note — container OOM at canary caused by rare prompt size spike, mitigated by scaling. Follow-up: add protective limit and better telemetry on prompt-size distribution.
Meera: added note to runbook and linked IDS-412.
Sara: marking this deploy as COMPLETE. Thanks team. :tada:
